stories.title: The Saga of Metallica and the Shattered Realm
stories.tagline: Elves, men, dwarves, orcs, cats and crocodiles: seven hundred and twenty-five years of war, snow, pumpkins and ash.

stories.title: The Saga of Angelica and the Sovereign Bridge
stories.tagline: A unicorn queen, eleven human crowns and a road laid in secret across the sea: three hundred and eighteen years of peace, patience, conquest and walking trees.

stories.title: The Crucible of Three Factions
stories.tagline: A ring of sand, a forbidden green heart, and three peoples held apart for two hundred years. Then the Harbinger, the gourds, and a god.
